messages:
Anya: quick sync — need to lock PRD acceptance criteria for the next API iteration (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank). Customer asks piled up; want clear launch gates.
Sam: +1. can we capture perf SLOs per endpoint? e.g. p95 <= 300ms for chat-completions on dedicated tier. also throughput targets for batching.
Leila: for ML, we need regression test sets per model family and a failure budget for quality drift. propose: 1k prompts / weekly eval, and fail if mean ROUGE/f1 drops > 2%.
Mike: SDK changes to support rerank param `candidate_ordering` — devex needs a simple migration guide and examples. also streaming UX for chat.
Jin: repeating customer asks: 1) deterministic rerank seed for reproducibility, 2) embeddings stable across minor model patching, 3) clear error codes for low-confidence rerank.
Anya: good. let's bake those into acceptance criteria. I'll draft a minimal checklist.
Alex: from QA: acceptance tests I want automated E2E for: 
```
- chat: request/response latency + token-based billing sanity
- embeddings: embedding shape + cosine similarity sanity on canonical vectors
- rerank: idempotence when candidates permuted
```
Also add flaky-test thresholds so CI doesn't block rollout unnecessarily.
Tess: UI note for console: rerank results should show score delta and original candidate snippet. names: prefer `score_delta` over `scoreChange`. small but helps telemetry queries.
Sam: infra notes: routing policy needs to prefer cheaper model variant under high load, with automatic fallback to baseline model. config example: `routing.policy = ["latency", "cost"]`
Leila: edge cases: very long context + rerank candidates with token overlap -> KV-cache blowup. acceptance criteria must include memory regression tests and a fallback to truncation + warning header.
Mike: add migration doc item: `Breaking changes? none expected but param deprecated: ranking_method=v1 -> v2`. include code sample and recommended client pin.
Jin: customer-driven priority: prioritize reproducible scores (seed) over slight speed improvements; customers in finance/regulatory care a lot.
Anya: draft acceptance checklist (will paste here shortly). Aim: minimal launch gates, enforceable by QA + CI.
Anya: DRAFT CHECKLIST:
```
- API contracts: schema stable, documented examples for chat/completions, embeddings, rerank
- Acceptance tests: automated E2E passing on main with test vectors
- Performance: p95 latency targets met on dedicated and hosted tiers
- Quality: model regression tests with thresholds defined
- Observability: per-route cost/latency breakdown + trace id included
- Migration: SDK guide + deprecation notes
- Edge cases: long-context memory test, empty candidate set behavior, non-ASCII handling
- Compliance: KMS integration tested for private deployments
- Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error budget breach
```
Sam: +1. can we add a metric for rerank determinism: same inputs + `seed` -> identical ordering 100%?
Leila: yes, and tolerance for non-determinism when models updated; tie it to model version pinning.
Alex: will implement tests. need stable test vector repo location — @Mike can you create `devex/acceptance/testvectors/rerank`?
Mike: on it. will add README and example curl commands.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: service/redwood-api -> revision 2026-03-20-canary. Monitoring hooks: latency, error-rate, rerank-determinism.
Anya: thanks all. next steps: I will turn this into a PRD section and ping engineering for an RFC review tomorrow. if anyone has must-have acceptance items, shout now. :pray:
